METHOD. ffmpeg -ss <t> -frames:v 1 whole frames (never a cropped zone) at ~1.2-1.5 s across the full 0-24.8 s of each render, denser (0.1 s) at every transition, plus a numeric top-zone ink scan (fraction of non-background pixels in the visual zone above the seam) over 0-24.6 s at 0.3 s and over each suspect window at 0.1 s. pointing_cues.py --vid minimaxh3 returns "cues": [] ("no pointing cue in this take"), so missing_source_post is not in play on any render.
Spoken argument: MiniMax H3 = #2 video model, behind Seedance 2.0 (#1), above Grok Imagine (#3); the only open-source/open-weight one of the three and significantly cheaper; then the follow CTA. All three renders draw exactly that: a 2/1/3 podium built in speech order, then a three-chip row gaining an open-book vs closed-book row and a $ vs $$$ price-tag row, then the handle card.
